directive: 目的、場所、人物、達成条件、報酬、時系列を正確に保って説明する。

entries.EN: Barkeep: "Duty has a reputation to uphold. That's why they want this thing done quietly. All you need to do it whack the stalker called Lucky and bring his PDA as proof."
entries.JA_current: バーキープ「デューティーにも守らなきゃならない評判がある。だから、この件は内密に片づけたいんだ。ラッキーというストーカーを始末して、証拠に奴のPDAを持ってきてくれ」
entries.JA_new: バーキープ「デューティーにも守らなきゃならない評判がある。だから、この件は内密に片づけたいんだ。ラッキーというストーカーを始末して、証拠に奴のPDAを持ってきてくれ」

entries.EN: To join Duty, you will need the approval of one of the most respected fighters in the group and also prove to Duty's leader that you are worthy of your place in their ranks.
entries.JA_current: デューティーに加入するには、部隊でも特に信頼の厚い隊員から推薦を得る必要がある。さらに、隊員としてふさわしい人物だと指揮官に認めてもらわなければならない。

entries.EN: Barkeep: "Your mission is to kill Tyran, the leader of the Mercs. His crew made it into the Wild Territory and set up a base at the construction site. Be careful, some of their fighters have set up ambushes on the way to the site. Bring me Tyran's PDA and the reward is yours."
entries.JA_current: バーキープ「任務は、マーセナリーズの隊長ティランの始末だ。奴らは荒廃領域に入り込み、建設現場を拠点にしている。現場までの道には、待ち伏せしている連中もいるから気をつけろ。ティランのPDAを持ってきたら、報酬を払う」

entries.EN: General Voronin: "The war with Freedom is coming to an end, Marked One. You played your part in fighting for the cause! Now I want to finish this war. The leader of Freedom must be disposed of."
entries.JA_current: ヴォロニン将軍「フリーダムとの戦いも終わりに近づいている。マーケッド・ワン、君も大義のためによく戦ってくれた！ ここで決着をつけたい。フリーダムのリーダーを排除してくれ」
entries.JA_new: ヴォロニン将軍「フリーダムとの戦いも終わりに近づいている。マーケッド・ワン、君も大義のためによく戦ってくれた！ ここで決着をつけたい。フリーダムのリーダーを排除してくれ」

entries.EN: Captain Ivantsov: "...before we get to the formalities, you have to pass an easy test. You have to get a folder from the abandoned building opposite from here. It's not hard, just go inside, take the folder and bring it to me. Piece of cake, right? When I have the folder we'll decide whether you're fit to join Duty or not."
entries.JA_current: イヴァンツォフ大尉「正式な手続きの前に、簡単な試験を受けてもらう。向かいの廃屋から書類のフォルダーを持ってきてほしい。中に入って、取って、私に届けるだけだ。簡単だろう？ フォルダーを受け取ったら、君がデューティーにふさわしいか判断しよう」

entries.EN: Hunter: "Bring back the rifle. I lost it by the place where bloodsuckers live. I'll upload you the co-ordinates. And be careful, those bastards ain't no joke."
entries.JA_current: ハンター「ライフルを取り戻してくれ。ブラッドサッカーのいる辺りでなくしちまったんだ。座標を送る。気をつけろよ、あいつらは洒落にならん」

entries.EN: Wolfhound: "We've got a little hunt going on here. We pinned the scientists down over there behind the chopper. My boys are putting some suppressing fire down on them from time to time to make sure they don't escape. Join in, we're about to go in and finish 'em off. If you help us I'll give you the scientists' suit... we found it in the chopper we took down. Your target is professor Kruglov. Kill him or he'll run away during the shootout, I know his type. If you kill him, the suit is yours. If you don't, you don't get jack."

entries.EN: Barkeep: "You have the protective prototype to cover yourself against the Brain Scorcher, I know the coordinates of a bunker. Don't forget that the prototype can't protect against the emission forever, so you must get to the bunker under the antennae and find a way to shut down the emitter. Should be a way to switch them off somehow."

entries.EN: Kruglov: "Stalker, help! We were attacked by some mercs and half of our team is dead. Help us and you won't regret it"\n \n "...be careful, there are about fifteen of them, but we don't know for sure."
entries.JA_current: クルグロフ「ストーカー、助けてくれ！ マーセナリーズに襲われて、仲間の半分が死んだ。助けてくれれば必ず礼はする」\n \n「気をつけてくれ。敵は15人ほどいると思うが、正確な数は分からない」

entries.EN: Kruglov: "We were returning to Yantar, when the Mercs shot us down. People say that they only need the information we carried, but I know better - they'll put us all down like rabid dogs. Help me get back to Yantar and I'll tell you what I know about your Brain Scorcher, and I'm sure the barkeep will pay you well for it. I make a bad warrior, but I know the way, so I'll lead and you cover us along the way."
entries.JA_current: クルグロフ「ヤンターへ戻る途中で、マーセナリーズに撃ち落とされた。連中の狙いは私たちの持つ情報だけだと言う者もいるが、そうではない。私たち全員を狂犬のように撃ち殺すつもりだ。ヤンターへ戻るのを手伝ってくれれば、ブレイン・スコーチャーについて知っていることを話す。バーキープも、きっと十分な報酬を払ってくれるだろう。私は戦闘には向かないが、道は分かる。先導するから、援護を頼む」

entries.EN: Barkeep: "You need to question the scientists and find out where Lab X-16 is located to search for those documents."
entries.JA_current: バーキープ「科学者たちに話を聞いて、ラボX16の場所を突き止めてくれ。そこで書類を探すんだ」
entries.JA_new: バーキープ「科学者たちに話を聞いて、ラボX16の場所を突き止めてくれ。そこで書類を探すんだ」

entries.EN: I looked through the documents found at the Institute. It appears that the Institute was used as a front for an unofficial lab called X-18 in the years preceding the accident. This lab hosted a number of very unusual experiments; its location is not clear from the documents and the military don't seem to know anything about it either. Well, well... the plot thickens... But perhaps, this is the starting point which the traders need. Now I have to travel further North to a trader known as the Barkeep.

entries.EN: Hell... Lab X-18 wasn't fun... And its current residents... I didn't think creatures like that even existed. I found some documents... I didn't understand much of what was written in there except that they contained technical specifications for some components for Kaymanov emitters. What's interesting is that the parts were destined for another lab with the codename X-16 and it's probably a secret facility as well.

entries.EN: Hmm... The traders have dug up a lot of information about these laboratories. The Barkeep wasn't surprised to find out about the emitters and X-16. Now he's convinced that this Brain Scorcher is man-made. He thinks that Lab X-16 is near the scientists' camp by Lake Yantar. It's interesting that they're studying emissions that resemble the effects of the Scorcher. So now I must pay a visit to the Zone's scientific community.

entries.EN: I met with the Barkeep. Having looked through the documents from the Institute he thinks that this X-18 is in the so called Dark Valley and asked me to go there to look for information and documents. He says he sent Duty scouts to get into the underground vaults there but they disappeared. The Barkeep thinks they were captured by bandits who have a base nearby. If that's true, everything those Duty guys found will be in the hands of Borov, the leader of the bandits. The Barkeep told me to be careful and... clearly didn't tell me everything about these underground vaults. Oh well, time to get to work: first of all I need to go pay Borov a visit and if the "conversation" goes well, I'll explore the underground.

entries.EN: Well, I am ready to go to the Scorcher. I found out from Crazy the times when the emission levels decrease. He also told me about a safe place where I can wait for these periods. My psi-protection won't work at other times anyway. I'll have to find a way into the underground bunker of Lab X-10. Inside I should find the controls for the Brain Scorcher antennae.
